messages:
sarah: FYI support flagged an uptick in p95/p99 for Hosted chat last night right after we rolled the continuous-batcher threshold change. customer noticed several 5–10s tails. attaching quick notes below.

sarah: repro from their account: ~200 small prompt requests/sec, median latency fine, p99 spikes at ~6s in a 10m window.

sarah: saw change 730a2f1 -> adjusted `hold_ms` from 12 -> 40 and `max_batch_size` from 64 -> 128 in the rollout.

kai: ugh. increasing hold is usually to improve throughput but that can hold tiny requests and blow tail. did the rollout include grace_window tweaks?

mohit: not sure about grace_window. I can pull traces and sampler profiles. pinging ops-bot for recent deploys.

ops-bot: deploy-event: service=hosted-inference, env=prod, user=deploy-bot, commit=730a2f1, time=3955550000. config: {hold_ms:40, max_batch_size:128, grace_ms:16}.

kai: ok grace_ms stayed at 16 per the bot. that combo (hold 40 + bigger batch size) will cause long waits when request arrival is thin but bursty — small prompt single-token requests get stuck waiting for batch fill.

linh: grabbing histogram and trace links now — https://grafana/redwood/prod/hosted/p99?from=3955548000&to=3955554000

linh: snippet from trace: 
```
request_id=abcd1234, queue_wait=3900ms, kvcache_miss=false, decode=1200ms
```

mohit: queue_wait ~3.9s matches p99. looks like coalescing is waiting to hit batch threshold or hold timeout.

kai: short-term mitigation: lower hold_ms back to 12 or 8 for this pool and reduce max_batch_size to 64. Also enable dynamic-burst-detection for that tenant so we don't penalize tiny prompts.

linh: can apply a config override to the customer shard, test for 30m and watch p99. want me to patch?

sarah: yes please. also include a temporary fallback policy to route to the fast-path model variant (no batching) for that tenant if p99 > 2s.

mohit: i'll submit the rollback PR for the config change (revert 730a2f1) and a targeted override for the tenant. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/commit/revert-730a2f1 (WIP)

kai: for long-term: we should add an automatic detector that flags when p95–p99 diverge after batching config changes and auto-suggests smaller hold or per-tenant overrides. file a follow-up ticket?

sarah: created ticket INF-8123: "batcher config: detect p99 regressions + suggest per-tenant overrides". assigned to eng-platform.

linh: patch applied to shard "acme-inc" at 3955554200: hold_ms=10, max_batch_size=64, fallback-route=fast-path. monitoring now.

ops-bot: alert resolved: p99 for hosted-inference.acme-inc dropped from 5.8s -> 480ms over 10m.

mohit: leaving the rollback PR open for record; will merge after postmortem notes.

kai: short notes for postmortem: 1) changed hold_ms too high for bursty small-prompts 2) max_batch_size increase amplified queueing 3) missing canary-per-tenant checks 4) mitigation = targeted override + fallback route.

sarah: thanks team. follow-up: schedule a 30m retro tomorrow to make the detection + canary change. :thumbsup:
